result.title: 3 Tips to Save Money With ChatGPT
result.description:
ChatGPT can help you find ways to save, whether you’re shopping for a desk chair or wondering what you’re still paying for after a free trial ends.

Learn three ways to save money with ChatGPT. Use a product screenshot to compare prices before you buy, spot subscriptions you no longer use, and build a monthly budget that leaves room for things you enjoy.

Looking for a better deal? Try ChatGPT before your next purchase: https://chatgpt.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=tips_to_save_money&utm_content=shopping_cta

Want a closer look at your spending? Explore ChatGPT Finances: https://chatgpt.com/finances/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=tips_to_save_money&utm_content=finances_cta

result.title: Create and Share a Dashboard in ChatGPT
result.description:
Turn your analysis into a dashboard your team can use. Building on the fictional Acme sales example, this walkthrough brings quarterly metrics and customer follow-ups into one view.

See how to inspect the data behind a chart, edit its appearance, ask questions about the numbers, and refine the dashboard with annotations. The video also covers refreshes, matching your branding, and sharing through Sites with connected data.

Sites data connections and viewer access:
https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sites/data-and-connections

Publishing and sharing a Site:
https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sites/publishing-and-sharing

Connection and refresh options depend on your workspace and the data source.

Part 4 of the Data Agent series.

result.title: Ask Questions About Your Data in ChatGPT
result.description:
Prepare for a sales meeting by asking ChatGPT what changed in your data and which customers need attention. Using sample data from the fictional company Acme, this walkthrough compares quarterly sales, visualizes the segments behind the change, and explores customer orders alongside account notes.

See how to ask follow-up questions, check which sources ChatGPT is using, and turn the findings into a concise three-slide presentation for your team.
